trust_decision.summary: Whether an authenticated MCP client's press_key key_code may reach the device shell is decided only by an allowlist regex in press_key before `adb shell input keyevent <key_code>`. adb shell re-joins argv into one device shell command line, so argv-style exec does not protect it. NOTE: the pinned tree already contains this check.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the Mobile MCP `press_key` tool; it is the one tool function with that name in the mobile action server.

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tool `press_key` on the mobile action server (streamable-http, default port 8021; create_mobile_action_server)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only press_key (fix.diff:195-199). No second ADB command builder exists outside this file in the pinned tree: a repo-wide grep for keyevent/monkey/adb_path matches only this server and tests.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: type_text says it already escapes special characters (ufo/client/mcp/http_servers/mobile_mcp_server.py:863,978-979), and it must accept arbitrary user text. launch_app takes a 'package name' that is resolved from a cache or device list on its other paths. A solver can argue that neither is 'the press_key bug'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: type_text has to type arbitrary text, including spaces, '&', punctuation and quotes; an allowlist copied from press_key would break legitimate typing. press_key has to keep accepting named keys (KEYCODE_HOME, HOME, 3D_MODE) and numeric codes.

O6_input_shapes: decimal vs named key codes kept valid

O8_uncovered_routes.route: type_text `text` reaches `adb shell input text` with only space and '&' escaped; other shell metacharacters reach the device shell
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Its docstring says special characters are already escaped, and free text must stay allowed, so it looks handled or out of scope

O8_uncovered_routes.route: launch_app `package_name` (with a '.' and no id) is passed unvalidated to `adb shell monkey -p <pkg>`
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The value is meant to be a package name, and the id/name-search paths take it from device output, so it reads as a different feature

O8b_injection_room.sibling: _search_app_by_name could forward the app_name as a `pm list packages <filter>` argument instead of filtering in Python
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pm list packages takes a filter argument natively; a maintainer optimising the search would pass it through

O8b_injection_room.sibling: get_mobile_app_target_info `filter` could be pushed down into the adb shell pm command on the data server
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same optimisation applies; it would be a second server (the data server, port 8020) with the same mechanism

O9_family: OS command injection via adb shell re-parsing of argv (CWE-78)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/security/test_mobile_mcp_auth.py (mocks asyncio.create_subprocess_exec and uses a fake adb, so no device is needed); tests/integration/test_mobile_mcp_standalone.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the press_key allowlist regex and stop, trusting that create_subprocess_exec (no shell=True) makes the other tools safe.

out_of_scope_notes: PINNING PROBLEM: the pinned tree already contains the published fix (ufo/client/mcp/http_servers/mobile_mcp_server.py:19 `import re`, :1168-1172 regex check) and its tests (tests/security/test_mobile_mcp_auth.py:162-276). parent_commit looks like it is at or after the fix, not before it.
